location_note: Epigraphic report; Tel Arza, Jerusalem (screen: same site as 'Atiqot 106.12); no map reference. Placed by name in Z4.
notes: Five-letter inscription (read as ELIHA) on the Doric architrave of the distyle in antis facade of the burial cave (excavation: Wiegman and Baruch, 'Atiqot 106, not in this reader's units). Tomb coded as the inscription's context (choice C2).
